owner_direction: Make the next step very large, preserve useful prior requests/proposals, and inject a huge amount of visible material/content into the game.
non_negotiables: Peter Jackson film chronology and outcomes remain authoritative.
Moria order remains Watcher -> entry/dead-city discovery -> Balin chamber Orc/Troll escalation -> Bridge/Balrog -> Gandalf fall -> escape.
Primary route readability comes from landmark silhouette, architecture, light and terrain before UI.
Optional dressing may not block traversal, quest anchors, companion recovery or save continuity.
30 FPS floor target remains Windows DX11 1280x720 Low-Medium; no invented performance acceptance.
Production100, rendered visual acceptance and target-device acceptance remain evidence-gated.

production_strategy.material_strategy: Mass-enrich existing project-owned MTL palettes with explicit roughness/metallic intent using the existing M_ProductionSurface importer before scaling texture resolution or synchronous asset-bank size.
production_strategy.geometry_strategy: Add bounded low-cost modular architecture/prop kits around existing quest anchors and reuse them in deliberate composition rather than spawning unbounded unique actors.
production_strategy.loading_guardrail: Direct synchronous LoadObject hotspots are already recorded; do not multiply heavyweight banks without transition-hitch measurement. Small project-owned modular assets are allowed in this wave, with exact-head engine proof.
production_strategy.source_governance: Use source files to drive silhouette, state, route, lighting and encounter composition. Visual-only material must not override film/script-supported facts.

moria_wave.identity: monumental abandoned dwarven kingdom; darkness, mines and halls; human-scale contrast against vast geometry
composition_rules: Keep the main route readable and centered.
Use side architecture to imply a much larger city without opening unsupported traversal.
Use warm light pools sparingly against deep cool darkness.
Do not add alternate outcomes for Watcher, Balrog or Gandalf.

followup_regions.Amon Hen: broken woodland lanes, ancient ruin silhouettes, river-to-battle transition, Lurtz film-locked outcome
followup_regions.Isengard: Orthanc silhouette, black stone, pits/furnaces, felled landscape, later industrial/flooded state separation
followup_regions.Rivendell: pale stone/wood integration, terraces, water, soft daylight and council-space readability
followup_regions.Lothlorien: gold-white filtered light, vertical organic platforms, refuge/recovery mood and low clutter
followup_regions.Anduin: river scale, shoreline travel gear, Argonath framing and readable camp transition
followup_regions.Shire/Bree/Road/Weathertop: final material/lighting/architecture polish after the higher-priority dramatic regions
